data.name: PowerCorp
data.detailed_description:
PowerCorp is a space sim survival game set in 2188 in our solar system. You are returning from Jupiter’s moon Io to Earth from a routine maintenance mission when something awakes you from hypersleep. You wake to a crippled reactor. Your ship is dying, and each decision costs you power. You need to get home across a real-scale solar system using true orbital mechanics, manage critical systems and gather resources. At the same time, you try to figure out what has happened, why nobody answers, and why humanity seems to have disappeared.

Stranded in a damaged spacecraft, every system you activate, every course correction you make, every moment you stay alive drains your crippled reactor. There are no arcade physics. No convenient refueling. Just you, the cold mathematics of orbital mechanics, a solar system that doesn't care if you make it home, and a mystery to solve.

The same game can be played in two modes, in a top down perspective, meaning your primary movement takes place across a flat 2D plane, or can be played with full 6dof in a full 3d space.


Power Is Everything

Every action has a cost. Running life support, firing thrusters, even checking your instruments. It all drains from a reactor that's never going to be enough. Prioritize. Sacrifice. Survive.

Key features

  • True Orbital Mechanics

    Navigate a real-scale solar system using actual Kepler-newton physics. Execute gravity assists, and feel the weight of every miscalculated burn.

  • Pilot or Command

    Fly your ship directly with Newtonian physics, drift, thrust, rotate. Or manage systems through an immersive terminal interface. Thread asteroid fields, execute precision docking. Every maneuver matters.

  • Systems Under Pressure
    Life support. Propulsion. Power distribution. When emergencies hit, you'll juggle failing systems, make brutal tradeoffs, and learn that sometimes saving one thing means losing another.

  • A Mystery Written in Silence
    Something happened in the solar system while you slept. Piece together the truth on your long journey home — if you survive long enough to learn it.

  • No Two Journeys Are the Same
    Procedural elements ensure each playthrough offers different challenges, encounters, and choices — while the core mystery remains for you to unravel. 

The Sun is a distant star. Earth is months away. Your power is failing.

Every decision costs something. Every mistake could be your last.

And something is lurking.. no one answers.

How far will you go to get home?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Graphics API: Vulkan 1.2 (preferred) / DirectX 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti 8GB / AMD RX 6700 XT 12GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Graphics API: Vulkan 1.2 (preferred) / DirectX 12
